{"question":"If I move from GitLab BV in the Netherlands to GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand, how will my life insurance coverage change?","answer":"In the Netherlands you receive death benefits through the pension scheme, including a lifelong partner’s pension and a temporary dependent’s pension, whereas in New Zealand GitLab does not offer life insurance benefits and employees rely on government payments or personal arrangements.","evidence_a":"Death benefits are included in your pension scheme to protect your loved ones.

Coverage & Key Features

* Lifelong partner's pension for spouse – see section 8 of the Pension Scheme
* Temporary dependent's pension for children
* The beneficiary is also entitled to an additional partner's pension that is bought by the invested pension capital upon death – see section 18 of the Pension Scheme","evidence_b":"GitLab does not plan at this time to offer Life Insurance benefits because New Zealanders can access government payments and services to help if they get ill, injured or have a disability.

Many New Zealanders choose to access life insurance through their KiwiSaver provider or other personal arrangements."}
